# gramlot-js-server 0.2.14 — Core 0.3.6 server API

Requires `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.3.6 or later, which changes the server API.

Node/Bun server (`@gramlot/gramlot-js-server`):

- Each browser is its own owner. The page response sets the cookie `gramlot_owner` (Path of the mount prefix, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, a session cookie). The rpc and close requests read it. A browser without the cookie of a page can neither call nor close it. `ownerForRequest`, when given, replaces the cookie.
- The adapter calls the core server API and keeps only HTTP: `decodeBody` (a leading byte order mark is removed; a body that is not UTF-8 answers 400), `close(text)`, `companionFile`, `themeFile` and the `index.html` mapping of `openPage`.
- Every 405 answer carries `Allow`. The runtime file answers `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
- Every `GramlotServer` serves `/themes/`, not only a `GramlotFileServer`. Companion files below the pages folder are still served for a `GramlotFileServer` only.
- The gallery stages pages that export no `Logic`. The staged companion is `export *` of the page module.

Serverless (`@gramlot/gramlot-serverless`):

- `WorkerServerAdapter` is a core `ServerAdapter` that hands out the Worker transport. The transport has no synchronous call: `gramlot.rpc.callSync` throws the core error, and a `dataRemote` with `sync` reads asynchronously. `mount` passes `nameSyntax` to the page.
- The theme of a page (the base theme unless the page sets `css_theme`) is part of the export. The single file inlines it. The directory export copies it. A page does not need to declare the base theme.
- In a logic bundle, `@gramlot/gramlot/page` resolves to a module that exports every name of that core entry, read from the entry itself. A `Logic` that imports `Bag` or `createDecimal` builds and runs.
- The gallery gives a staged companion only to a page module that exports `Logic`.
- `@gramlot/gramlot` is a peer dependency, as in the server package. `@genrojs/builders` is required at 0.6.0 or later.

Project scaffolder (`@gramlot/create`):

- The templates do not declare the base theme: the server and the export provide it.
- The generated project requires `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.3.6 or later.

The three packages keep one shared version.

Verified with the tests of the three packages: server 40, serverless 43, create 3.
